rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for soldiers or the armed forces as a whole.
Use this for a specific organized military detachment or unit, including an armoured unit, rather than the armed forces in general.

example.english: The armoured troop is in position.
example.jyutping: zong1 gaap3 bou6 deoi6 ji5 ging1 dou3 wai6

rows.note: Use this construction for a group of primates, meerkats, or other animals, replacing N with the animal noun.

example.english: A troop of monkeys is grabbing food.
example.jyutping: saan1 soeng6 jau5 jat1 kwan4 hau4 zi2 coeng2 sik6

rows.note: Choose this when the troop is explicitly a cavalry unit; an armoured troop is normally called 部隊 instead.

example.english: The cavalry troop charged into the battlefield.
example.jyutping: kei4 bing1 deoi6 cung1 jap6 zin3 coeng4
